conclusion: NP允许目标结构参考时，主要观察增量可由同结构直接谱证据重现；analog额外增量、参考缺失泛化和排行榜增益尚未确认。优先独立来源确认直接检索。

config.fold_rule: Sort unique truth canonical by SHA256('20261017|015|'+canonical), round-robin 0..4; every domain/scenario copy shares its canonical fold.
config.sample_weight: Each query total 1.0; each scenario total 0.5; candidates equal weight within query/scenario. No class_weight and no rescaling of total weights.
config.scaler: Logistic only: StandardScaler.fit(X_train, sample_weight=train_weight); no held-out rows enter statistics. HGB uses raw features.
config.ranking: Descending predicted positive probability within same-formula original top50 slots; original candidate_position breaks exact ties; remaining v9 order unchanged.
config.interpretation: OOF development evidence, not unseen-encoder-structure proof or leaderboard gain. HGB_analog versus HGB_baseline measures added direct+analog feature value together; shuffled is an imperfect negative control retaining direct features and maximum reference Tanimoto.

feature_config.peak_removal: precursor +/-1.5Da; oligomer additionally known intact monomer +/-1.5Da; frozen experimental hypothesis
feature_config.query_spectrum: maximum original peak count, first on tie, inherited v9 representative
feature_config.candidate_shortlist: first 50 of reconstructed v9 order; keep full v9 tail unchanged
feature_config.reference_identity: 005 RDKit canonical_group_key; representative output_smiles lexical first per canonical
feature_config.hash_exclusion: all spectra of all 500 existing NP/G1 queries; exact raw float64 array SHA256
feature_config.no_truth_reference: remove all 500 canonical labels globally BEFORE query-specific reference retrieval
feature_config.reference_selection: same polarity; neutral mass +/-200; nearest2000 then top80 unique canonical by spectral best
feature_config.spectral_channels: union of direct and precursor-shift matching edges, product-descending greedy one-to-one; shift only both monomer singly charged and same polarity
feature_config.analog_aggregation: top80 positive-quality unique canonical; exclude candidate self, maxT,sum(qT)/sumq,max(qT),mean(top5qT),q_at_max(qT)
feature_config.shuffle_control: query/scenario reference qualities permuted with fixed seed20261017; same identities and Tanimoto, direct unchanged
feature_config.fingerprint: RDKit remove stereo + canonical tautomer + Morgan radius2, 2048 bits
feature_config.scope: repeatedly used development data; reference removal does not undo pretrained encoder exposure

boundaries: 反复使用的500开发canonical；OOF不是本项目独立新面板，不能证明encoder预训练未见。
B只允许目标结构参考，NP203/250实际有，G1为0/250；正direct质量NP185个top50真值，G1为0。
A在选参考前全局移除全部500真值canonical，是已声明的标签驱动评价干预，不是生产可用oracle分支。
精确hash排除不能保证来源/采集独立或排除重处理谱；删除前体和完整单体后5query残余强度不足10%。
direct_quality是同canonical参考的联合direct/shift谱质量；analog去掉候选自身引用。
shuffle保留真实谱选出的参考身份、maxT和direct，只改变query内质量对应。
事后direct-only保持原折/参数，不改原结果；多方案和长期开发选择偏差未包含在bootstrap区间。
仅原v9top50同式槽位重排，不增加候选召回；50k参考抽样不是全库检索上限。
全数据模型只是实验资产，尚未集成Kaggle端到端推理，public仍0.323。
